name: Igoudar Dakhla Green Data Center
developer: Moroccan Ministry of Digital Transition and Administrative Reform; Ministry of Energy Transition and Sustainable Development; Dakhla-Oued Eddahab regional authorities; Mohammed VI Investment Fund; CDG and public/private partners
notes: Agreement launched strategic studies for a next-generation green data center complex in Dakhla with target capacity of 500 MW. Earlier 2025 sources report government partnership agreements for Igoudar Dakhla, 100% renewable power, cloud/hosting/storage/data-processing and AI/HPC workloads; no construction start or operation date found.
